amendment_reason: Sequentially unloading base-only and then loading the adapter condition inside one Python MPS process caused severe second-condition memory pressure and unusable runtime.

changed_execution_only.before: Both model conditions ran sequentially in one Python MPS process.
changed_execution_only.after: Each model condition runs in a fresh offline Python process and writes a condition artifact; a no-model combiner performs the frozen comparison.

evidence_boundary: The interrupted sequential-process attempt is excluded. Only independently completed condition artifacts are formal evidence.
